stimuli.description: A neutrally colored and furnished office-like room (3.9m×3.8m×2.5 m) with false windows. Two types of ceiling-mounted fluorescent lighting: warm white (3000 K, reddish) and cool white (4000 K, bluish), both at 500 lux.

limitations: Gender differences in short-term recall performance were difficult to interpret as genders were evenly induced in both moods and the material was not gender-related.
